recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if FHIR-I explicitly decides to move the general guidance to the communication-pattern list or add per-option cross-references.
issue_request: FHIR-41441 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core workflow issue asking that workflow patterns acknowledge prerequisite orchestration and reference-resolution work so options such as direct posting of a request do not look simpler than they are.
initial_application: Commit b14c140d35 applied the issue by adding the approved paragraph to source/workflow-ad-hoc.html before the ad-hoc workflow options, including Option B. Later same-file history from FHIR-55135 was a spelling/abbreviation cleanup that preserved this guidance.
additional_context: FHIR-I workflow minutes from 2024-01-08 corroborate the persuasive-with-modification disposition. A later Jira comment suggested possibly placing the clarification at workflow-communications.html#commpatternslist with an Option B reference, but no adopted replacement resolution or conflicting community evidence was found. publish.ini lists the workflow pages as active published pages, and the communication-pattern list links directly to the ad-hoc page where the guidance appears.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Moving or copying the paragraph into workflow-communications.html would not change the current implementer-facing meaning and would risk duplicating guidance without a final work-group instruction.
